scholarships.name: UAB International Scholarship
scholarships.description: Renewable for four years (eight semesters) for first-year, full-time, degree-seeking international undergraduates with GPA 3.0+/4.0. Application deadlines: May 1 (Aug intake) and November 1 (Jan intake).

scholarships.name: Blazer Elite Scholarship
scholarships.description: UAB's flagship merit award for top freshman applicants — covers tuition for four years, includes summer research stipend.

scholarships.name: Blazer Distinguished Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based award for high-achieving freshmen — renewable for four years.

scholarships.name: BSMART Scholarship
scholarships.description: Single application covering UAB departmental, IB and performance scholarships. Application deadline April 1.

scholarships.name: Heersink Pre-Med Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for outstanding applicants planning pre-medical studies leading to UAB Heersink School of Medicine.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.description: US Department of State global scholarship for graduate study at UAB — full tuition, stipend, travel.

accommodation.name: Blazer Hall (On-Campus)
accommodation.text: Современная резиденция рядом с Campus Green — suite-style комнаты с общими ванными, ориентирована на первокурсников.

accommodation.name: Blount Hall (On-Campus)
accommodation.text: Резиденция для upper-class студентов — apartment-style комнаты с собственной кухней и living room.

accommodation.name: Camp Hall (On-Campus)
accommodation.text: Классическая residence hall в самом сердце кампуса — traditional double rooms, общие ванные.

accommodation.name: Rast / Gold / McMahon Halls
accommodation.text: Кластер резиденций у Campus Green — suite-style с en-suite ваннами, common lounges на каждом этаже.

campuses.title: UAB Main Campus
campuses.text: Единый кампус площадью 636 акров в Southside district Бирмингема — 216 зданий, ~16 миллионов кв. футов. Включает академические корпуса 12 школ, UAB Hospital, спортивные сооружения Blazers, Campus Green.

campuses.title: UAB Medical Center
campuses.text: Крупнейший медицинский комплекс штата — UAB Hospital (1,207 коек, 8-й по размеру в США), Heersink School of Medicine, O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center (единственный NCI-designated центр в регионе).

paragraphs: The University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) is a public research university founded in 1969 in Birmingham, Alabama. Classified as R1 — Doctoral Universities, Very High Research Activity — UAB received $715 million in research grants in FY 2022, making it one of the top research powerhouses in the American Southeast. The university is home to over 20,900 students from more than 110 countries spread across 12 academic divisions.

UAB is internationally recognized for its medical and health sciences ecosystem: the Heersink School of Medicine, School of Dentistry (Alabama's only dental school), School of Optometry, School of Nursing, School of Health Professions, and School of Public Health all sit on the same campus as UAB Hospital — the 8th largest hospital in the United States with 1,207 beds — and the O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, the only NCI-designated cancer center in the Alabama region.

Beyond medicine, UAB offers strong programs through the College of Arts and Sciences, Collat School of Business, School of Engineering, and School of Education and Human Sciences. Notable areas include Computer Science (with a flagship MS in Cyber Security), Biomedical Engineering, Neuroscience, Psychology, and the UABTeach STEM-teacher pipeline. Times Higher Education ranked UAB the #1 Young University in the US in 2018-19.

International students join through direct freshman admission with conditional pathway support. UAB's compact urban campus in Birmingham's Southside is a 636-acre walkable district connecting academic buildings, residence halls, the Campus Green, and the UAB Medical Center. The Blazers compete in NCAA Division I (American Conference) across 18 varsity sports.
paragraphsRu: University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) — государственный исследовательский университет, основанный в 1969 году в Бирмингеме, штат Алабама. Имеет классификацию R1 — Doctoral Universities, Very High Research Activity; в 2022 финансовом году UAB получил $715 миллионов research грантов, что делает его одним из ведущих исследовательских центров на юго-востоке США. В университете учатся более 20 900 студентов из более чем 110 стран в 12 академических подразделениях.

UAB международно признан благодаря медицинской и health sciences экосистеме: Heersink School of Medicine, School of Dentistry (единственная стоматологическая школа Алабамы), School of Optometry, School of Nursing, School of Health Professions и School of Public Health расположены на одном кампусе с UAB Hospital — 8-й по размеру больницей США (1 207 коек) — и O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, единственным NCI-designated раковым центром в регионе Алабамы.

Помимо медицины, UAB предлагает сильные программы через College of Arts and Sciences, Collat School of Business, School of Engineering и School of Education and Human Sciences. Среди заметных направлений — Computer Science (с флагманской MS in Cyber Security), Biomedical Engineering, Neuroscience, Psychology, а также UABTeach — pipeline подготовки STEM-учителей. Times Higher Education присвоил UAB #1 Young University в США в рейтинге 2018-19.

Международные студенты заходят через прямой freshman admission с поддержкой pathway. Компактный городской кампус UAB в Southside district Бирмингема — это walkable district площадью 636 акров, объединяющий академические здания, резиденции, Campus Green и UAB Medical Center. Команда Blazers выступает в NCAA Division I (American Conference) в 18 видах спорта.
